source.description: Data source: Suno API feed (api, default) or the extension's cached database (db)

max_songs.description: Safety cap on songs scanned (default 2500, max 20000). Set truncated=true in the result means more remain.

tools.description: Read the song library cached in the BetterSuno extension's IndexedDB (songsList) — no Suno API calls. Includes Suno model version and played status. Populate the cache with the extension's "Fetch Songs" button first; requires the extension to be connected.

include_stats.description: Include aggregate stats over all matching songs (per-model, V6 coverage, played/unplayed)

tools.name: search_by_lyrics
tools.description: Search the user's own songs for a lyric phrase. Matching is case-, punctuation-, and whitespace-insensitive. When the BetterSuno extension is connected, candidates come from its IndexedDB cache (fast, no feed pagination) and can be narrowed with created_after/created_before; full clips are then fetched in batches to inspect metadata.prompt. Falls back to paginating feed/v3 when the extension is unavailable.

query.description: Lyric phrase to find (case- and punctuation-insensitive; line breaks and extra whitespace are ignored)

created_after.description: Only songs created on/after this date. Accepts ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM (month start)

created_before.description: Only songs created on/before this date. Accepts ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM (date-only values include the whole day/month)

source.description: Candidate source: auto (extension DB, fall back to feed), db (extension DB only), api (paginate feed/v3)

max_songs.description: Maximum candidate songs to inspect (default 2500). Applies to DB candidates and the API fallback.

include_lyrics.description: Include the full lyrics (metadata.prompt) for each match
